concepts.design: 구리빛 비대칭 로브·초록 눈·부드러운 다이아몬드형 얼굴·딥그린 랩드레스
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a full-body transparent sprite concept of a NEW attractive Yujin design for an adult romantic visual novel. Fictional adult woman age 28-32, fully clothed, mature curves.
Input1 is a contact sheet of FOUR EXISTING HEROINES. Its purpose is an EXCLUSION/CONTRAST REFERENCE and a rendering-family reference. DO NOT depict any person from this sheet. Their identity combinations are forbidden: blonde high ponytail with turquoise eyes; brown tied low hair with brown eyes; navy waist-long straight hair with blunt bangs and violet eyes; ash-beige long waves with violet-gray eyes. Do not recreate their face templates with a color swap. Preserve thin clean contours, refined anime eye rendering, soft restrained cel skin and coherent fabric shading across face AND whole body.
Input2 is ONLY reference for the original adult Yujin body silhouette, basic stature and relaxed upright stance, NOT hair, NOT outfit. Replace all old hair/clothes completely.
Create the INDIVIDUAL face specified below: change cranial silhouette, jaw width, cheek fullness, eyelid contours, brow shape, nose and mouth silhouette; do not use the same small V-face/almond-eye template for every concept. Attractiveness should come from adult facial harmony, expressive gaze and warmth, never threatening sharpness. Natural unpainted lips, no cosmetics, no heavy blush. No glasses, headwear, watches, choker, props, tattoos or beauty marks. Single tiny simple ear stud per visible ear or bare ears; normal ears with one lobe and believable helix, no skin bumps or duplicated jewelry. Hands fully visible, relaxed hanging at sides, anatomically coherent thumb plus four fingers on each, clean nails, natural finger lengths, no fused extra fingers. Adult body proportions and polished fully coherent outfit including shoes, plausible tailoring and fastening.
Centered 1024x1536 portrait, FRONT face and front standing body, level shoulders, full head and shoes with safe margins, arms down. A single complete sprite only. TRUE transparent alpha background, no floor, aura, gray painted backdrop, glow, labels, text, watermark, inset or panel. No photo or 3D rendering.
Concept 11 FACE AND HAIR: Deep burnished COPPER ORANGE sleek shoulder-skimming asymmetrical lob, off-center side part, smooth swept fringe and one ear tucked. Adult DIAMOND face: wider upper cheekbones, softly squared lower jaw instead of a tiny V, short rounded chin. Horizontally broad open emerald-green eyes, flatter upper lids with gently rounded lower lids; straight low friendly brows, subtly longer petite nose bridge, medium-width naturally full closed smiling lips. Composed confidently affectionate direct gaze.
OUTFIT: Deep forest-green knee-length wrap dress with a diagonal wrap neckline, short softly tailored sleeves, broad self-fabric tied waist sash, modest overlap skirt and cognac closed-toe block-heel pumps. Bare ears. Sophisticated mature feminine silhouette.
